title: Nutty Indulgent Polish Almond Pudding
description: A rich and buttery Polish dessert featuring ground almonds, perfect for special occasions, and can be adapted to be sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the ground almonds, sugar substitute, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, heavy cream, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the almond mixture to the wet ingredients and whisk until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 6 buttered ramekins or small cups.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25 minutes, then reduce the heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
